i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load issue #99 body, the confirmed conversation direction (doctrine generalization + Commander consumption + two lifted ideas), global-orchestrator.md critical-review section, explorer SKILL.md design-it-twice/excursion/critic sections, commander SKILL.md mission-frame/plan sections. Record pass when loaded.

q1.title: When does plan-alternatives (plan-it-twice) fire in a Commander run?
q1.imperative: The capability being added: Commander's plan step generates parallel plan alternatives before execute.json freezes. Settle the trigger/weight rule — always-on, mission-frame-scaled (skip trivial with stated reason), or epic-only. This sets per-run cost for every future issue. Ask the human with a recommendation.
q1.finding: Mission-frame-scaled (option a) with a bias to YES: default is to run plan-alternatives; skip only when genuinely trivial, and any skip must be surfaced explicitly as an 'untaken road' (named skip with stated reason, visible to the human at plan approval), never a silent omission.

q2.title: Scope of the always-on plan critic (today epic-only)
q2.imperative: The issue says a lightweight always-on plan critic before plan-approved. Settle: does 'always-on' include trivial/mechanical issues, and what panel scaling applies below epic weight. Ask the human with a recommendation.
q2.finding: Plan critic rides the same dial as plan-alternatives (bias to YES; trivial skip must be surfaced as a named untaken road). Panel scaling below epic: single cold critic for ordinary plans, existing 3-lens panel at epic weight; human triages every finding; critic reads candidate plan + mission frame only, no authoring context.

q2b.title: Refinement: panel scaling below epic
q2b.imperative: Human refined q2: prefer panels at lower weights too; single critic acceptable only for fairly easy plans; panel-vs-single is a Commander complexity call, and the choice made is always surfaced to the human at plan approval.
q2b.finding: Panel-vs-single critic is a Commander complexity judgment (single only when the plan is fairly easy; hard stories get the panel; 'when in doubt, panel' stands), and the chosen panel size is explicitly reported to the human at plan approval — same loud-choice rule as untaken roads.

consolidation.summary: As prior consolidation, amended: critic panel size below epic is a Commander complexity call with a preference for panels (single only for fairly easy plans; when in doubt, panel), and the choice is surfaced to the human at plan approval alongside any untaken roads.
